messages:
ravi: Heads-up: Finance flagged a tiny spike where customers were billed twice on streaming + retry paths. Seen with redwood-small-v1, canary traffic. Ticket FIN-337.
claire: any sample trace ids?
ravi: got one from support: trace=zt-8892. Looks like stream truncated, client retried, routed to a different node and a toolcall executed again.
jo: this smells like idempotency gap. Our tool-runner dedupe is per-route only. If router falls back to stable, dedupe key changes.
max: Confirmed. The ledger shows two provisional rows, both later committed. No tombstone dedupe fired because keys differed.
claire: Do clients ever send toolcall ids? I thought we encouraged it for tool invocations.
ravi: some do, but this customer didn’t. The runtime currently doesn't synthesize ids for mid-stream toolcalls.
jo: Could we compute a deterministic id at the runtime based on the prefix bytes? E.g. prefix_hash = sha256(first_k_bytes) and include as X-Tool-Id. That would be stable across reconnects if the prefix is identical.
max: Good idea. Needs caution: cached prefix changes could alter bytes; but if we canonicalize to tokenization or normalized bytes it should be stable.
lee: Alternative: ledger-level cross-route provisional dedupe for a short window. Any provisional credit that matches (acct, prefix_hash) within 20s should be considered a duplicate. Cheap to implement and catches quick retries.
claire: Both approaches complement each other. Synthetic tool id reduces re-exec, TTL dedupe protects during rollout weirdness.
ravi: Quick mitigation plan: 1) add TTL dedupe in ledger; 2) have runtime emit prefix-sha header for mid-stream toolcalls; 3) add alerting metric for "double-provisional-toolcall" counts by model/route.
jo: For the runtime header, cap prefix bytes to 4KB to avoid heavy hashing. Also expose a debug flag to log the generated id for tracing.
max: I'll prototype the ledger-side dedupe (PR to accounts/ledger). Claire, can you own the alert/dashboard tile? We should show per-model, per-route spikes and a small list of trace ids.
claire: yep. I'll add a Prom metric: toolcall_double_provisional_total{model,route} and a Grafana panel.
lee: Ops-bot: FIN-337 created and assigned to eng-platform.
ops-bot: <@ravi> Ticket FIN-337 created: https://internal/p/FIN-337 (eng-platform).
ravi: Thanks. Also, let's run a backfill script to detect affected customers and prepare adjustment patches if needed. I'll coordinate with finance after we have the query.
claire: One more UX item: the console currently shows provisional then final; in this case users saw two final charges. We should add an explanatory note in billing UI when the reconciler merges duplicates due to retries.
jo: Agree. I'll follow up with a small RFC on consistent toolcall id generation across router/runtime/toolrunner.
max: If anyone can pair on reproducing with the canary toggled to 100%, ping me.
ravi: Thanks folks. We'll triage next steps in the FIN ticket and aim for a canary fix next week.
